name: Blion
text: Blion reported ticket 2214 at lunchtime; the west stairwell door jams whenever the latch is wet. Maintenance will bring a new closer kit Thursday.

name: Raizner
text: Customer Raizner could not sign in to the tenant portal this morning, even after a password reset. Support verified the mailbox alias and reopened case 8830 for the identity team. A callback is booked for tomorrow.

name: Stathis Nahvi-Djoo
text: Stathis Nahvi-Djoo raised ticket 5520 because the parcel room camera keeps losing its feed overnight. Building services swapped the power adapter but the fault returned within two days. A replacement unit is on order, and the tenant has been told to expect a visit next Monday.

name: Hascoet Cameira
text: Hascoet Cameira flagged the broken buzzer on flat 9 this morning. The panel lights up but nobody rings through, so deliveries keep piling at the entrance.

name: Edrian
text: Edrian sent ticket 6612 after the kitchen extractor started rattling above the fryers. Nobody wants to work that station while the noise continues. An engineer is due Friday morning with a spare motor and mounting bolts.

name: Laver
text: Resident Laver opened case 4193 about the gym ceiling leak that keeps soaking the mats near the squat rack. Staff roped off the area and placed two buckets beneath the worst drip. Roofers will inspect the membrane once the rain stops, probably Thursday, with scaffolding ready.

name: De Boo
text: De Boo filed ticket 7791: the loading dock roller shutter will not close fully, leaving a hand-width gap overnight. Security wants a same-week repair.

name: Lolo Annalyn Oliapuram
text: Lolo Annalyn Oliapuram reported the north lift stopping between floors twice before breakfast. The alarm worked, but the doors stayed shut for several minutes each time. A technician has been booked and residents were emailed.

name: Donny
text: Donny logged ticket 3388 about the persistent damp patch spreading across the archive room wall. Files stored on the lower shelves have started to curl at the corners, which nobody noticed until this week. Dehumidifiers are running now, and the wall will be opened up to trace the pipe.

name: Canossi
text: Dr. Canossi raised ticket 9021: the consultation room thermostat reads six degrees higher than the corridor sensor. Patients keep asking for fans during appointments.

name: von Ostheim
text: von Ostheim opened case 4477 after the courtyard gate code stopped working for the whole east block. Two couriers were stuck outside for twenty minutes yesterday. A locksmith will reprogram the keypad and issue fresh codes.

name: Mayada Medrado
text: Mayada Medrado reported ticket 6150 about the broken step at the south entrance, which has already caused one twisted ankle. The concrete crumbled after last month's frost, and the handrail wobbles as well. A mason is scheduled for Wednesday, weather permitting, with temporary tape up until then.

name: Priore
text: Priore from unit 214 filed ticket 7788 about the intercom buzzing all night. The panel was reset twice, and the noise came back within an hour.

name: Sevdush
text:
Sevdush, the courier form you sent this morning is missing the depot stamp, so the carrier rejected the whole batch. Could you resend it with the stamp and reference 55-204? The afternoon pickup leaves at four.
Thanks,
Dispatch Desk

name: Plader
text:
Dr. Plader, your referral packet reached our clinic yesterday, but page three is blank on both copies. Could you have the records office refax the missing section to 555-0119 before Friday? We cannot schedule the scan without it. The patient has been offered a provisional slot on the fifteenth.
Regards,
Clinic Front Desk

name: Raymund Kapor
text:
Raymund Kapor, the venue has moved tonight's rehearsal to the upper hall because of the floor works. Doors open at six. Please tell the choir.
Thanks,
Hall Office

name: Yaowaluck Ohl
text:
Yaowaluck Ohl, your expense claim 88-341 has been returned because the taxi receipt is dated before the trip began. Please attach the correct slip or add a note explaining the mismatch. Approvals close Thursday at noon.
Best,
Payroll

name: Xhihan
text:
Xhihan, thanks for covering the late desk shift on such short notice. Two things before you lock up: the back door needs the deadbolt as well as the latch, and the parcel trolley must go inside the cage. The alarm code changed last week; please check the new card. I owe you a coffee.
Cheers,
Front Desk

name: Hendricks
text:
Ms. Hendricks, the print room queue is stuck on your thesis file again. Please collect the pages before five, or they will be recycled.
Thanks,
Library Desk

name: Zeïn Elicio Nsakala
text:
Zeïn Elicio Nsakala, your locker deposit refund was processed on Tuesday and should appear within three working days. If the amount looks wrong, reply with the original receipt number. Accounts can amend it quickly.
Regards,
Accounts Team

name: Giclat Campioni Reedy
text:
Giclat Campioni Reedy, the catering quote for the spring dinner finally arrived, and it is about a fifth over the budget we agreed. I have asked them to split the drinks from the food so we can compare. Your thoughts before the committee meets on Monday would help.
Best,
Events Office

name: Yayesh
text:
Yayesh, the printer on level two is eating envelopes again. Can you log it before the mail run at three?
Regards,
Ops Room

name: Verzaro
text:
Dr. Verzaro, the second ultrasound appointment has been moved to the Riverside annex because the main scanner is being serviced. Parking there is free for patients. Please arrive fifteen minutes early with the referral letter.
Regards,
Imaging Desk

name: Iker Achille
text:
Iker Achille, the membership renewal failed because the card on file expired in March. We have held your booking until Friday. To keep the same slot, update the payment details in the portal or call the club. After Friday, the lane goes back to the waiting list.
Best,
Club Office

name: Joos Vinayagamoorthy Popprath
text:
Joos Vinayagamoorthy Popprath, the archive key still has not come back from your department. Could you check the drawer by the copier?
Thanks,
Records Team

name: Barkate
text:
Mr. Barkate, your seat on the Thursday coach has been moved to the front because of the motion sickness note on your booking. The driver has the updated list. Boarding starts at half past six.
Regards,
Travel Desk

name: Liam
text: Ticket 3340 came in just before seven: the pool cover winch jammed halfway, so the pool stayed closed all morning. Liam traced the fault to a frayed cable and taped off the area. A replacement cable arrives tomorrow, and the morning swim session is cancelled again.

name: Dikenmann
text: Case 7810: the vending machine on floor three swallowed two notes and then went dark. Facilities called Dikenmann, who services the unit and knows the reset procedure.

name: Misrak Perré
text: Ticket 2299 concerns the squealing belt in the laundry room dryer, which maintenance ignored twice. Misrak Perré finally recorded a clip, and the repair was escalated this morning. Parts should arrive by the weekend.

name: Malia Anna-Maria
text: Report 5602 is about the noise from the rooftop plant, which now runs past midnight. Neighbours on the top floor have complained three times this month. Malia Anna-Maria measured the levels on Tuesday and agreed they exceed the lease terms. A sound engineer is being asked to quote.

name: Pascal-Olivier
text: The cafeteria fridge has been warm since Monday, and nobody logged it properly. Pascal-Olivier noticed the milk turning and put in request 4471 today.

name: Romanca
text: Ticket 9127: the lift phone connects to an empty office after six. Residents pressing the button hear nothing but static. Romanca from the security desk tested it twice and raised the fault priority.

name: Jaïda Vasilia
text: Case 6713 was opened after the parcel shelf in the mailroom collapsed for the second time this quarter. Boxes spilled across the corridor, and one courier nearly tripped. Jaïda Vasilia reinforced the bracket on a temporary basis and ordered a steel replacement, promising a permanent fix by the month's end.

name: Yihao Farai Molcanová
text: The stairwell sensor light flickers all night and wakes the ground-floor flats. Yihao Farai Molcanová has asked for ticket 2216 to cover a full sensor swap.

name: Philiberta
text: The delivery bay drain backs up whenever it rains hard, and the smell reaches reception. Philiberta reported it last Thursday, then again on Monday when the water spread. A drain crew is booked for the weekend.

name: Cacic
text: Ticket 4880 tracks the recurring power cuts in the east wing, now happening most mornings between nine and ten. The backups hold, but the lifts reset each time. Cacic from building control suspects a failing breaker and has scheduled a full inspection, with a temporary generator on standby for next week.

name: Bartholomew Celeste
text: The smoke detector in the study room chirps every few minutes and distracts everyone. Bartholomew Celeste swapped the battery, yet ticket 5503 stays open because the chirp returned.

name: Minh Espelleta
text: Case 3301: the garden irrigation timer runs at midnight and floods the path by the bins. Two residents slipped before anyone connected the noise to the schedule. Minh Espelleta adjusted the valve and will replace the controller next week.

name: Siobhan
text:
Subject: Rehearsal room booking for the winter concert. The hall you requested is already taken on the ninth, so I penciled you into the annex instead. Siobhan, could you confirm the piano is tuned before the first session? If the annex is unsuitable, ring the office and we can shuffle the slots.
Regards,
Music Office

name: Taraki
text:
The quote for the roof repair came in higher than we discussed. Ms. Taraki has asked for a breakdown before the board meets.
Best,
Estates

name: Almina Neissa
text:
Thanks for sending the revised schedule. One clash remains: Almina Neissa is booked for two rooms at the same hour on Thursday. Please move the smaller session. Everything else works.
Thanks,
Scheduling

name: Tya Shia
text:
Subject: Fire drill feedback. The marshals cleared the east wing in four minutes, which is our best time this year. Tya Shia noted that two stairwell doors were propped open and has asked for signage. Could each floor lead confirm their roll call by Friday?
Regards,
Safety Office

name: Emily
text:
Quick stocktake update: the south aisle is done, Emily counted the whole bay alone. Start the north side after lunch with the new scanners.
— Floor Ops

name: Csáti
text:
Thanks for the meter readings. Two flats still show unusual usage, and Dr. Csáti wants those checked before the billing run. Could your team revisit on Tuesday morning with the portable logger?
Regards,
Billing

name: Munib Luciene
text:
Subject: Storage room clear-out. The old files are going to the shredder on the twenty-eighth, so anything you want kept must be moved to the cage before then. Munib Luciene will label the shelves on Friday. Anything left after that gets collected without warning.
Regards,
Facilities

name: Shorsh Gjemali
text:
The handover notes are in the blue folder. Shorsh Gjemali added the spare key codes and flagged the faulty light on level one.
Cheers,
Night Desk

name: Kenan
text:
Your visitor pass for Thursday is ready at the front desk. Kenan will meet you in the lobby around ten and walk you through the site rules. Bring photo identification.
Regards,
Reception

name: Fouassier
text:
The annual safety walk happens next Wednesday, and this year the route includes the roof plant. Warden Fouassier has agreed to lead the group and will bring the harnesses. Please wear flat shoes and arrive ten minutes before eight. Sign the sheet at reception.
Best,
Site Office

name: Insa Niman
text:
Delivery confirmed for Thursday between eight and ten. Insa Niman will sign for the pallets if the lab is still locked. Leave the invoice on the bench.
Thanks,
Goods In

name: de Vaan
text:
Following the water test, the kitchen taps are clear to use again. Results will be logged here once de Vaan has retested on Monday and checked the final sample. Until then, bottled water stays available in the corridor.
Regards,
Estates
